svg.aria-label: Plate 02, SANGAM. Links complaints from three offices and three languages into one case file. F1 85 percent against 25 percent for rules alone, on synthetic data.

g.text: ROHITH RAJAN V · CATALOGUE OF WORKS
Three offices, three languages, one case file.
Synthetic data we wrote ourselves, so it reads high.
After Fellegi and Sunter, 1969, a theory of record linkage
